records.claim: The use of some medications during pregnancy may cause temporary symptoms in newborns soon after birth. These symptoms are sometimes referred to as withdrawal. Babies exposed to risperidone near the time of delivery should be watched for stiff or floppy muscles, drowsiness, agitation, tremors, trouble breathing, and problems with feeding. In most cases, symptoms would be expected to go away in a few days without any long-term health effects. Not all babies exposed to risperidone will have these symptoms. It is important that your healthcare providers know you are taking risperidone so that if symptoms occur, your baby can get the care that is best for them.
records.source_section: I need to take risperidone during my pregnancy. Will it cause withdrawal symptoms in my baby after birth?
